The industrial discovery gap

Buyers need a solution. Most websites give them a document library.

Industrial buying starts with a technical question: which pump suits this fluid and pressure? Which automation solution works with this line? Which HVAC system meets this application? Product knowledge is available, but rarely organized around how buyers decide.

01 / Fragmented

Knowledge sits everywhere

Specifications, brochures, configurations, and application expertise are spread across systems, folders, pages, and people.

02 / Hard to navigate

Technical buyers work too hard

Visitors must interpret terminology, compare documents, and guess which product line or application path is relevant.

03 / Expensive to resolve

Sales teams repeat discovery

Pre-sales and application teams spend valuable time answering early-stage questions that a guided experience can clarify.

The AiGenLabs approach

A private AI advisor built around how industrial buyers decide.

We begin with one high-value product line or solution area, create a governed product-knowledge layer, and turn it into a useful public-facing advisor.

01

Structure the product knowledge

Map product families, attributes, applications, compatible options, documentation, and ownership.

02

Build the discovery journey

Translate engineering and sales expertise into the questions, comparisons, and paths a buyer needs.

03

Launch a grounded AI advisor

Deploy a branded agent on the website that answers from approved content and guides visitors to the right next step.

04

Continuously evolve the experience

Use approved knowledge changes and visitor behaviour to improve coverage, recommendations, and journeys.

Experience outcomes

Make technical product knowledge easier to use.

The goal is not a generic chatbot. It is a more useful digital route from a buyer’s requirement to relevant product information and technical guidance.

Better-informed enquiriesCapture application context before a visitor reaches the right team.
